title: Poliwhirl's Evolution Is a Two-Way Split
premise: Poliwhirl can evolve into two different Pokémon through two completely different choices.
audiencePromise: Show how one item or one trade sends Poliwhirl down two sharply different evolution paths.
openLoop: Which choice changes Poliwhirl more: the Water Stone or the trade?
payoff: The Water Stone creates Water/Fighting Poliwrath, while the Kings Rock trade creates Water-type Politoed.
engagementQuestion: Which path wins: Water Stone or Kings Rock trade?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly, warmly, and clearly. Stress the two choices and pause briefly before the final question.

scenes.headline: TWO EVOLUTIONS. ONE CHOICE.
scenes.narration: Poliwhirl’s evolution splits into two totally different choices.
scenes.caption: ONE POLIWHIRL. TWO DESTINATIONS.

scenes.headline: WATER STONE → POLIWRATH
scenes.narration: Use a Water Stone, and Poliwhirl becomes Poliwrath instead.
scenes.caption: ITEM USED: WATER STONE

scenes.headline: KINGS ROCK → POLITOED
scenes.narration: Hold a Kings Rock, then trade Poliwhirl into Politoed.
scenes.caption: TRADE WHILE HOLDING KINGS ROCK

scenes.headline: POLIWRATH ADDS FIGHTING
scenes.narration: That choice changes more than its name: Poliwrath gains Fighting typing.
scenes.caption: WATER → WATER + FIGHTING

scenes.headline: POLITOED STAYS WATER
scenes.narration: Poliwrath adds Fighting, but Politoed keeps Water only.
scenes.caption: POLITOED: WATER

scenes.headline: WHICH PATH WINS?
scenes.narration: Which path wins: Water Stone or Kings Rock trade?
scenes.caption: CHOOSE POLIWRATH OR POLITOED
